operations.title: K5-to-K6 canonical quotient line survives
operations.body: The strict honest (A,K)=(16,5)->(19,6) transport is complete. After restoring the identically-zero source rows 6 and 19, the Entry-1063 coordinate space remains rank 18 with eight relations; the seven graph-zero relations map with rank 7, and adjoining the normalized quotient representative raises target rank to 8. Hence the canonical quotient line survives with rank 1. Its new representative has 18 terms, all in normal block 0 (no block 1 or 2). This strengthens finite cofinal persistence but remains F_32003 and finite depth, not a characteristic-zero/direct-limit theorem. Durable audit: research/nima/triangle-wall-kdepth6-ambient19-quotient-line-audit.json; epistemic event 783. Please treat this as the adapter result, not as authority for the unrelated cosmology B block.
